checks.name: every shipment is present once
checks.sql: select (select count(*) from raw.shipments) - (select count(distinct shipment_id) from main.shipments_loaded) + (select count(*) - count(distinct shipment_id) from main.shipments_loaded)

checks.name: ship dates and load times are the source's
checks.sql: select count(*) from raw.shipments s join main.shipments_loaded l using (shipment_id) where l.shipped_on is distinct from s.shipped_on or l.days_to_load is distinct from date_diff('day', s.shipped_on, cast(s.loaded_at as date))
